themes.description: Users are unable to use earned cashback for bill payments and recharges, citing changes in terms and conditions.
themes.business_impact: Decreased user satisfaction and a high likelihood of churn, as users feel misled and find the app no longer useful.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The company has changed the terms and conditions for cashback redemption, without properly communicating this change to users.
themes.action_plan: • Review and revise the cashback program to ensure clear communication of terms and conditions, restore previous redemption options or provide suitable alternatives, and consider implementing a transition period for affected users.

themes.business_impact: Frequent support requests could lead to increased churn rates and negative word-of-mouth advertising.
